640	Before that?	Antes disso?
641	What did he get wrong at all?	Em que ele errou, afinal?
642	Rather, the Gemara says, Berachot 4a, that Israel were worthy	Mas a Guemará diz, Berachot 4a, que Israel era digno
643	of a miracle in the days of Ezra, like the one done for them in the days of Yehoshua bin Nun.	de que se fizesse um milagre nos dias de Ezra, como se fez nos dias de Yehoshua bin Nun.
644	When they came up from Babylon with Ezra, there should have been enormous miracles in conquering the land.	Quando subiram da Babilônia com Ezra, deveria ter havido milagres enormes na conquista da terra.
645	Like there was with Yehoshua bin Nun.	Como houve com Yehoshua bin Nun.
646	How did they conquer the land under Yehoshua bin Nun?	Como conquistaram a terra com Yehoshua bin Nun?
647	They went to rebellious Jericho.	Foram a Jericó, a rebelde.
648	Which soon will be swallowed entirely into the earth; there was the casino there, people lost	Que logo será engolida toda pela terra; ali havia o cassino, e as pessoas perderam
649	their socks, there were free buses from here, taking them to the casino.	até as meias, havia ônibus grátis daqui, levando-os até o cassino.
650	And the politicians said, it's fine, people lost their socks, their pensions,	E os políticos diziam: tudo bem, as pessoas perderam as meias, a aposentadoria,
651	everything was lost in that casino.	tudo se perdeu naquele cassino.
652	Thank HaShem it was lost, lost from the world.	Graças a HaShem que se perdeu, sumiu do mundo.
653	So it is forbidden to rebuild Jericho, and forbidden to build a city that would be called Jericho.	Por isso é proibido reconstruir Jericó, e proibido construir uma cidade que se chame Jericó.
654	Why did they call it Jericho?	Por que a chamaram Jericó?
655	They used to worship the moon.	Eles adoravam a lua.
656	Cursed Jericho, the rebellious.	Maldita Jericó, a rebelde.
657	Now, it had walls. What are thick walls?	Agora, ela tinha muralhas. O que são muralhas grossas?
658	Full of sorcery; it was impossible to break them down.	Cheias de feitiçaria; era impossível derrubá-las.
659	When Yehoshua came to the land, he circled Jericho seven times with his seven shofarot,	Quando Yehoshua chegou à terra, ele circundou Jericó sete vezes com seus sete shofarot,
660	they made a great blast, and suddenly a miracle happened: those fortified walls Jericho was so proud of	fizeram um grande estrondo, e de repente aconteceu um milagre: aquelas muralhas fortificadas de que Jericó tanto se orgulhava
661	collapsed and fell.	ruíram e caíram.
662	You see that it was all miracles.	Você vê que tudo foram milagres.
663	The Gemara says that when they came up from Babylon to conquer Eretz Yisrael a second time, they should	A Guemará diz que, quando subiram da Babilônia para conquistar Eretz Yisrael pela segunda vez, deveriam
664	have had miracles done for them too.	ter recebido milagres também.
665	Like what was done when Yehoshua bin Nun entered Eretz Yisrael.	Como se fez quando Yehoshua bin Nun entrou em Eretz Yisrael.
666	There were miracles, the wall fell; so too they were worthy of having miracles done for them.	Houve milagres, a muralha caiu; assim também eles eram dignos de receber milagres.
667	And why, indeed, were no miracles done for them in the second conquest?	E por que, de fato, não se fizeram milagres para eles na segunda conquista?
668	Everything happened in the natural way.	Tudo aconteceu pelo caminho natural.
669	The Gemara says: sin caused it.	A Guemará diz: o pecado causou.
670	Which sin?	Qual pecado?
671	They married foreign women.	Casaram-se com mulheres estrangeiras.
672	So they did not merit having miracles done for them.	Então não mereceram que se fizessem milagres para eles.
673	The Midrash says, according to the merit…	O Midrash diz: de acordo com o mérito…
674	Learn from here, from the Gemara, that according to the merit of the people, is the power of the miracles	Aprenda daqui, da Guemará, que conforme o mérito do povo é a força dos milagres
675	that the Holy One, blessed be He, does for us.	que o Santo, bendito seja Ele, faz por nós.
676	Listen once more: according to the merit of the people, so will the redemption come.	Ouçam mais uma vez: conforme o mérito do povo, assim virá a redenção.
677	If there are many merits, Torah, mitzvot and self-sacrifice, there will be miracles.	Se há muitos méritos, Torá, mitsvot e abnegação, haverá milagres.
678	And if not, everything will be through nature.	E se não, tudo será pelo caminho natural.
679	And so, now you understand why when they entered with Yehoshua there were miracles,	E assim, agora você entende por que, quando entraram com Yehoshua, houve milagres,
